ns2:course.label: Aquatic Sport Activities
ns2:course.description: Skills and knowledge essential for leisure-time activities which are classified as aquatic sport activities. Prerequisites for each aquatic sport activity are provided in the Class Schedule. More than one activity (Sections A through Z) may be taken in the same term.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: There will be a fee assessed for use of Campus Recreation equipment.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: Kinesio/Camp Rec Facility Fee $100.00 Flat Fee.
